title: What was successful with This One One Photo 3D
author: Express-Week-8312
selftext:
Well, I had just the one image of my subject, which just happened to be a little statue of one of my deceased relatives, no turntable and no second image of the same model. Because of such limitations, I would have to rigorously test all single image capture methods.

Tripo AI allowed for just having the one image and made a very convincing frontal view while using inference for the back. However, using the same tool, which allowed for additional views to be captured later on produced better and cleaner results. The limitation of the method was that with just a single image, the inference of the back would be made. But once the data of all four sides had been collected, an exponential improvement could be clearly seen. Therefore, Best is contingent upon the type of data sets you might have available to you.
